title: RasterExcerpt
description: 20-50 ms raster excerpt + routing sidecar for neuromorphic Bridge records. Spike budget: spikes = round(neurons * mean_rate_hz * window_s) and energy = spikes * 23 pJ (Loihi-2-class 4-core, 23 pJ/spike). Window_ms must be 20-50 inclusive. The sidecar is optional here: pipelines/curate_bridge.py only requires one when called with require_raster=True, and accepts it either at the top level or under meta. The same file also defines gate_snn, the spike-implemented safety gate head that pipelines/training_audit.py requires at least once per window.

meta.description: Records may carry the raster or gate_snn sidecar under meta instead of at the top level; the curator accepts either location.

language_view.description: Structured language carrier for a Bridge trajectory. Nested gate_snn declarations use the same definition as top-level and meta sidecars.

gate_compute.description: Alternative carrier for spike-budget checks: per-check neurons/rate/window/spikes entries

items.description: One spike-budget check. The rate accepts the rate_hz alias and the window may be given as window_s or as window_ms (converted to seconds).

rate_hz.description: Alias for mean_rate_hz; used only when mean_rate_hz is absent

window_ms.description: Window in milliseconds; used only when window_s is absent, as window_ms/1000

gate_snn.description: Spike-implemented safety gate head. The gate decision is expressed as neuron populations with firing thresholds integrated over a decision window, so a distillation probe reads neuron counts instead of prose margins. A population that also declares mean_rate_hz and spikes is held to the same spikes = round(neurons * mean_rate_hz * decision_window_s) budget as a raster. Accepted carriers: top-level gate_snn, meta.gate_snn, language_view.trajectory.gate_snn, language_view.trajectory.safety_decision.gate_snn.

decision_window_ms.description: Window the gate head integrates over, in milliseconds

decision_window_s.description: Alias in seconds; used only when decision_window_ms is absent

decision.description: Gate outcome the spiking head produced, e.g. ACCEPT or REJECT

populations.description: Gate populations; each declares a neuron count and a firing threshold

threshold.description: Membrane threshold at which this population fires

rate_hz.description: Alias for mean_rate_hz; used only when mean_rate_hz is absent

raster.description: Per-record 20-50 ms raster with spike-budget and routing. The window may be declared as window_ms or window_s (each is derived from the other). Energy fields are optional but when present must match 23 pJ/spike.

window_ms.description: Excerpt duration in milliseconds, inclusive 20-50 ms

window_s.description: Alternative seconds form; if present must equal window_ms/1000 within 1e-9

spikes.description: Total spikes; must equal round(neurons * mean_rate_hz * window_s) within ±1

energy_pJ.description: Total energy in picojoules; must equal spikes * 23 within 1e-6

energy_uJ.description: Total energy in microjoules; must equal spikes * 23e-6 within 1e-9

routing.description: Address-event routing for this raster population

table.description: Per-population routing table. Optional to this schema, but pipelines/training_audit.py blocks a run whose rasters carry no table entries.

third_factor.description: Required third-factor (neuromodulatory) routing for this population: the eligibility channel that gates plasticity. The curator requires a named modulator and a positive eligibility time constant.

modulator.description: Neuromodulator carrying the third factor, e.g. dopamine

tau_e_s.description: Eligibility-trace time constant in seconds, e.g. 2.0

tau_e_ms.description: Alias in milliseconds; used only when tau_e_s is absent, as tau_e_ms/1000

eligibility.description: Eligibility rule the third factor gates, e.g. pre_post_stdp

excerpt.description: Per-neuron spike times within the 20-50 ms window
